title: Media Buy Lineage Reason
description: Why a media buy succeeds an earlier buy of the same seller. Set once, at creation, alongside predecessor_media_buy_id. The enum is closed so buyers can branch on it; reasons outside it travel in `ext`.

enumDescriptions.renewal: The new buy continues the predecessor's commitment onto a new flight, typically on the same or similar terms.
enumDescriptions.terms_change: The new buy carries the predecessor's commitment under changed commercial or delivery terms that the seller cannot apply to the predecessor in place.
enumDescriptions.migration: The new buy moves the predecessor's commitment to a different product, platform, or seller-side configuration without a change in commercial intent.
enumDescriptions.sunset: The predecessor's product or program is being retired, and the new buy is its designated successor.
